label: GO step when choosing a2, mostly near the episode end (low value)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (94% of mass), and only when the agent picks a2 (99.8% of mass; never on a1 choices). Its strength tracks a strongly negative policy logit (choice < -8.9 holds 76% of mass). It does NOT fire at D2 and barely fires at D1. Within GO-a2 steps it fires on only about 16%, and these cluster late in the episode: ep_trial 90-99 holds 63% of mass, and the value head is low there (value < 5.2 holds 67% of mass). It is weaker but present after unrewarded previous trials (prev_reward=0 rate 1.9x), on episode trial 0, and when S2 is the good state. The recorded predicate (GO and a2 and ep_trial >= 85) gives dev F1 0.57 and mass recall 0.71. Adding a clause for prev_reward=0 with good=S2 raises dev mass recall to 0.88 but F1 stays at 0.56. The only FUTURE variable is action at GO, which is the agent own upcoming choice and is legitimate to compute; ep_trial is not observed directly but can be tracked by the agent. So: a late-episode / low-value a2-commitment unit.
